items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Craft or Scrap Armor
items.detail: Craft basic armor pieces at an armor workbench or scrap found armor

items.title: Craft or Scrap a Ranged Weapon
items.detail: Craft or scrap any ranged weapon like Combat Rifle or 10mm Pistol

items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Earn XP through kills, events, and quests or grind West Tek

items.title: Kill a Canine
items.detail: Fast travel to Autumn Acre Cabin for reliable canine spawns

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join a team and enter Daily Ops to kill Phantoms

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Bone
items.detail: Craft Bulk Bone Shards at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your C.A.M.P. shelter and place any decoration in the Decorations category

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is a reliable location

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted forms at a chemistry station

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find soap at Whitespring Resort showers or use a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take a board game from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat any raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms; you don't need to finish the operation

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find Infestations on the map and hunt Phantoms in the affected regions

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days during the week

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All rewards from Mutated Party Packages are available during this event period.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build and submit your best C.A.M.P. design inspired by the Slasher seasonal event.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event with special rewards and challenges available during the spooky season.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation rewards from Daily Operations and other event sources.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt Spooky Scorched enemies for seasonal rewards in designated locations.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points for all activities and quest completions.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish with new recipes and challenges available.
